title: Rav Chama bar Pappa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Sukkah 49b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.49b.13), but Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Chanina bar Pappa, and so it is in Yalkut on Psalms [36](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.727.3) and [103](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.859.9).
In [Kohelet Rabbah 10:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Kohelet_Rabbah.10.10.1): Rabbi Chama bar Pappa in the name of Rabbi Yehudah son of Rabbi Simon.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli and Kohelet Rabbah call him Rabbi Chama bar Pappa. Hyman’s heading calls him Rav. See also [Heilprin’s entry on Chama bar Pappa](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1363&lang=en).
The two linked Yalkut passages give Rabbi Chanina bar Pappa for the same teaching about the altar’s libation bowls. Hyman attributes Chanina to Dikdukei Soferim as well.
